ticket.notes: Student org wants 20 hoodies, size M, asking for a bulk discount.

args.summary: Drafted a reply explaining the available hoodie quantities, the currently blocked restock, discount and deposit terms, and the club's in-stock alternatives and add-on options.

drafts.subject: Your Yale AI Club hoodie order
drafts.body:
Hi Yale AI Club!

We can offer 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M from the shelf now. We can also check off any of the remaining 12 in M for a waitlist, but we can’t promise a restock yet. Bulldog Print Co. has an open $840 invoice (3 days overdue) and cannot ship while it remains unpaid; its 5-day lead time starts only after that invoice is paid, and no payment or restock purchase has been approved.

For context, after rent of $2,400 and invoice 501 are addressed, the shop would have $160 left. Restocking the 12-unit shortfall costs $264, which would leave -$104 and fall below the $500 cash cushion for optional spending. So we can’t commit to buying those 12 right now. If you’d like the 8 size-M hoodies now, they’re $58 each list price, or $52.20 each with the 10% student-group discount ($417.60 total). A full 20-hoodie order at that discounted price would total $1,044 and requires a 50% deposit of $522 before any restock purchase; we haven’t received that deposit. Even with a deposit, we would need to confirm the purchase before promising the remaining hoodies.

If you’d rather fill out the order from shelf stock, we have other navy hoodie sizes available: S (4), L (14), and XL (6). We can discuss substituting those for some of the M sizes. The student-group discount is 10%, and student ID is checked at pickup.

As a group-order add-on, each member can also get a Yale Cap (CC-HAT-BLUE) at the same 10% discount: 40 are available in OS, and the cap is $22 list price, or $19.80 each after the discount. Discounts can’t be combined. Custom club designs can also be discussed with staff.

Let us know whether you’d like the 8 M hoodies now, want to substitute other in-stock sizes, or would like us to note your interest in the remaining 12 while the restock is unresolved.

Campus Customs

drafts.body:
Dear Elm City Properties,
